statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and an open immersion j:U→V, with independent site and coefficient universes. Define Context, the ordinary and system tensor functors and comparisons, the source/open total complexes and their actual derived-functor representative counits, and RepresentativeLaws exactly as formerly defined in lem-pur-completed-open-tensor-representatives. Context contains coherent reduction calculi, exact open operations and their strict all-input semilinear comparison, the canonical integral closed structures, and completion and restriction comparisons pinned by their actual units. RepresentativeLaws asserts the ordinary localization square, the scalar-unit equation in every degree and coefficient level, and the whole-system localization square. These are interface definitions only: no object is chosen from an unproved existence theorem. All 21 declarations are relocated verbatim from the former item module, with no change of mathematical meaning.
